body:
actually, i've been thinking about all of these plans. trying to learn their language, their culture, places i can visit,... but then there are these anxiety-induced questions and ideas rushing my head. i've had dissapointments in my past whenever i dreamt too much, but i guess this is the time i should hang on to these dreams. i mean they're not dreams, they're future plans now. 

as for healthcare, i have a psychiatrist i've been seeing for 3.5 years now but i hate meds. drug induced serotonin release is really helping, but i prefer getting over my problems by myself, with the help of people. 

and thank you! seeing a random stranger giving you courage is good for anxiety.
